reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically sound, linking lattice distortion (MSAD) to solid-solution strength, dislocation inertia at cryogenic temperatures, and dynamic strain aging (PLC) at high temperatures, all well-established mechanisms in FCC alloys, though the specific role of Mn/Fe in PLC and the neglect of magnetic effects in DFT are minor gaps.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis is highly testable with a clear, multi-pronged experimental plan (CRSS vs. T, strain-rate jumps, TEM, DFT) and explicit falsification criteria, though the test description is somewhat redundant and the falsification statement is generic.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is very useful, providing a mechanistic framework to explain property differences across ternary to quinary alloys beyond simple constituent count, with specific, comparable predictions and a clear experimental roadmap.
